text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the removal of on-street accessible parking spaces for persons with disabilities.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the removal of on-street accessible parking spaces at the locations identified in Attachment 1 to the report (December 18, 2024) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
